stock.description: Flowing Cloud Technology Ltd operates in China, providing intelligent marketing technology services. The company delivers standardized Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) marketing platforms, built upon cutting-edge capabilities including AR/VR engines, AI behavioral algorithms, and cloud computing. These solutions are tailored to assist small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) across various sectors like e-commerce, education, and cultural tourism. Founded in Beijing, China, in 2008, the company is headquartered there.
